What if you ate the same food every day?
Meal prepping the same dish for a whole week is a popular trend. It's easy and saves time. Lots of people eat the same breakfast and lunch for years.

But here's the twist. Your gut bacteria love variety, and a big study found people who ate thirty different plants a week had a more diverse gut! Fruits, veggies, beans, nuts, seeds, herbs and spices all count as plants.
